storage.notes: 32GB built-in eMMC; also pairs with HomeBase S380.

features: 60 GHz mmWave radar, 120 view, up to 12 m (39.37 ft)
4K / 8 MP camera with f/1.6 wide aperture
AI human, vehicle and pet detection
adaptive lighting: white / warm / RGB, up to 500 lumens, adjustable
security mode and festive party lighting
eufy Security ecosystem, HomeKit (via hub), Google Home

frigate.notes: RTSP served via HomeBase S380, not the camera. Enable in eufy Security app. 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi (802.11 b/g/n/ax).

home_assistant.notes: No native ONVIF; use the HomeBase RTSP stream as a Generic Camera, or the eufy-security HACS integration (P2P).

blue_iris.notes: Use the HomeBase RTSP URL as a Generic/RTSP source (no ONVIF).
